# Zen Mesh — Stripe Webhook Operations

Version: 1.0.0
Last-Updated: 2026-05-25
Product: Zen Mesh — Stripe webhook ingestion, validation, delivery visibility, and security operations

Zen helps teams receive, validate, observe, and operate Stripe webhooks with stronger reliability, visibility, and security posture. Current readiness: DEMO (local/mock/sandbox only, not customer-ready or production-live).
